henry.title: Dad's Trip: Distance and Time to Scotland
henry.intro: Dad flies to Scotland! Let's do trip math. (About 12 minutes.)
links: Slide the clock and watch what time it is in Scotland.

steps: 1. Tap 🏫 After school. Read both clocks.
0.look: The sentence at the bottom tells you both times. Scotland time = New Mexico time + hours ahead.
0.q: Use the sim for questions 3, 4 and 5.

worksheet: Dad flies 8,000 km. That is about ____ miles. (8,000 × 0.6)
The plane flies 800 km in 1 hour. 8,000 km takes ____ hours.
It is 3:30 PM in New Mexico. Scotland time? Circle: 8:30 PM / 10:30 PM / 11:30 PM
Dad wakes at 7 AM in Scotland. New Mexico time? Circle: midnight / 7 PM / noon. Should you call? YES / NO
Challenge: Scotland is ____ hours ahead on Oct 25–31.

passage.text: ✈️ Dad's trip is about 8,000 km. One km is about 0.6 miles. So 8,000 × 0.6 = 4,800 miles.
passage.q: About how many miles is the trip?

passage.text: 🛫 A big plane flies 800 km in one hour. To fly 8,000 km, ask: how many 800s fit in 8,000?
passage.q: How far does the plane fly in 1 hour?

passage.text: 🌍 Scotland is 7 hours ahead of New Mexico. Add 7 hours to our time to get Scotland's time.
passage.q: Do you add or take away 7 hours?

words: kilometer, a way to measure distance
later in the day than us
how we measure distance in the USA
henry.challenge: The 'Oct 25–31' button: Scotland is ___ hours ahead. Walking 5 km a day, about how many days to walk 8,000 km? (8,000 ÷ 5)
